description: The debug console's ending commands. The game picks its ending when the final boss is beaten from two event flags: cybil_saved_flag (Cybil was cured in the amusement park fight) and good_path_flag (the Kaufmann subplot was completed). endings lists what SETENDING <name> sets them to; shown lists the flags GETFLAGS prints, in order, each with its label. Flag names are those of gamedata/flags. A mod patches this file like any data file.
